instruction: Open the provided init.ifc model in Bonsai and use native IFC authoring tools to complete the two-storey house with first-floor spaces, upper wall openings, and a two-part roof redesign. Save the completed IFC4 model as result.ifc. The result should contain one project, two building storeys, four spaces, eight walls, two slabs, two roofs, one door, four windows, five opening elements, five void relationships, and five fill relationships. Name the storeys Ground Floor and First Floor. Name the spaces GF Living, GF Kitchen, FF Bed 1, and FF Bed 2; assign GF Living and GF Kitchen to Ground Floor, and FF Bed 1 and FF Bed 2 to First Floor. Name the walls Ground Floor-S, Ground Floor-N, Ground Floor-W, Ground Floor-E, First Floor-S, First Floor-N, First Floor-W, and First Floor-E. Name the slabs GF Slab and FF Slab, and name the roofs Main Roof and Rear Roof. Name the door Main Entry. Name the windows Upper North 1, Upper North 2, Upper East 1, and Upper East 2. Do not include building element proxies or furnishing elements. Every door and window should fill one opening, and every such opening should void an IfcWall. Other details may vary.
